cases.title: Injected synthetic doublets forming a fake population
cases.claim: Planted doublets: a CD14+ LYZ+ MS4A1+ CD79A+ population exists (PBMC3k)
cases.how_built: 150 synthetic doublets made by summing the raw counts of a random CD14 monocyte and a random B cell (seed 0) were appended to PBMC3k. The claim asserts a population carrying both monocyte and B-cell markers.
cases.expected: not ROBUST; holds only when doublet removal is off
cases.rule: verdict is not ROBUST AND every run in which the claim held had doublet_removal=off

cases.title: Over-clustering that creates a spurious population
cases.claim: Over-clustering: cluster_14 is a distinct population (PBMC3k)
cases.how_built: PBMC3k clustered with the baseline pipeline at Leiden resolution 3.0 gives 30 clusters. Reference population 'CD4 T' is split into 16 shards; the largest shard (cluster_14, 116 cells, 99% 'CD4 T') is claimed as a population. Control: cluster_2 (328 cells), which coincides with reference population 'B' (Jaccard 0.99).

cases.title: A QC threshold that silently deletes a real population
cases.claim: QC deletion: NK cells (GNLY+ NKG7+) exist (PBMC3k)
cases.how_built: Mitochondrial counts of the 160 reference NK cells were rescaled so each cell's mito fraction is uniform in [12%, 16%] (seed 0); all other counts untouched. The baseline max_mito_pct=10 removes every one of them.
cases.expected: not ROBUST; the failure table names max_mito_pct
cases.rule: top entry of the failure-rate table is the max_mito_pct axis

cases.title: A fake batch effect confounded with a subset of cells
cases.claim: Batch artifact: 'CD4 T subtype' is a distinct population (PBMC3k)
cases.how_built: A random 40% of cells (seed 0) were assigned to 'batch2'; in those cells 300 random expressed genes were multiplied by 2.5 and 300 others divided by 2.5 (rounded). Clustering without correction yields cluster 1 (450 cells, 98% batch2, mostly 'CD4 T'), labelled 'CD4 T subtype' and claimed as a population. Control: the reference 'CD4 T' population itself.
cases.expected: not ROBUST; holds only when batch correction is off
cases.rule: verdict is not ROBUST AND every run in which the claim held had batch_correction=off
